about: Sector-pooled sufficient statistics of every engine job of the final runs (public/make_pooled_record.py; read by public/pooled_shim.py). Per job: names = all coefficients of the job (all_coeffs=True), need_names = the needed ones, R replicates, nsec sectors, T[i][r] = sum over sectors of the replicate values, M[i][j] = sum over sectors of the replicate sample covariance; exact, rounded to 25 significant digits. Built with the verbatim assembly/pooled_errors.job_sector_values().
